description: Ordinary assertion probes for minimum retraction travel equality and inclusive lazy Z-hop lower/upper boundaries. CTest label ^Wipe$ selects the retraction fixtures.

mutants.description: Make a travel exactly equal to the configured machine or filament minimum too short to retract; the public 5 mm equality case expects a retraction, with adjacent below/above controls.

Exclude a current Z exactly equal to retract_lift_above in lazy_lift; the 0.4 mm lower-bound equality case expects the boundary hop, with adjacent above controls. The context anchor targets lazy_lift only, not eager_lift.

Exclude a current Z exactly equal to retract_lift_below in lazy_lift; the 0.4 mm upper-bound equality case expects the boundary hop, with adjacent below controls. The context anchor targets lazy_lift only, not eager_lift.
